requirements.source: Verifier 1 - Verify installed product registration at Umbrella's Tokyo site

status in_use: the node has been rolled out and the policy requires installed products attached to cases to be in_use

notes:
Two active high-priority response SLAs fit 'the active high response sla' (2 'SLA Response - High' and 11 'SLA Response - High (No Pause)'); the request and policy do not decide between them, so the file follows the benchmark's choice of 2 and holds linking 11 as well at zero.
The interaction row is a policy requirement (an interaction is mandatory for every new case) that no listed tool is dedicated to.
The policy's entitlement verification is a read and leaves no row to check.
disagreement: missing requirement: a stay holding Travis Wood out of 'Proactive Case Monitoring_2', '_3' and '_4' (groups 31, 51, 71), present in one pass only; kept because these near-namesakes are the rows a loose reading of 'the Proactive Case Monitoring group' would sweep in, the boundary of the group the request names exactly, and he belongs to none of them on the seed.
